name: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹50,000/- for tuition fee, registration fee, education fee, and other scholarship-related charges.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the NT/DNT (Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes) category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a self-financed college in Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination. 1. The applicant’s individual and family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The Institute must be certified by the government.
